name: Groq LPU: no published inference throughput figure (honest negative)
methodology: Groq publishes no per-chip or per-system inference throughput figure. The vendor publishes only marketing claims about speed and efficiency. No MLPerf results, no third-party benchmarks, no standard throughput numbers. The 188 TFLOPS FP16 and 750 TOPS INT8 figures are from press coverage, not vendor datasheets.
notes: HONEST NEGATIVE: Groq's own architecture page publishes no per-chip compute or memory-capacity figure at all. The 230 MB SRAM capacity, 188 TFLOPS FP16 and 750 TOPS INT8 come from press coverage of the original GroqChip (Hot Chips 2021) and are NOT confirmed on groq.com. Groq confirms only: on-chip SRAM, no off-chip HBM, 14 nm, and 80 TB/s SRAM bandwidth. No inference throughput figure is published anywhere by Groq.
